summary: Braskem S.A. filed a 6-K reporting a Board of Directors resolution to seek protective measures under Brazil's Law 11.101/2005 (LFR) for itself and controlled companies, including a mediation proceeding with financial creditors and judicial Emergency Precautionary Relief. The company also authorized ancillary proceedings under Chapter 15 of the U.S. Bankruptcy Code and appointed Mr. Antonio Reinaldo Rabelo Filho as foreign representative. The filing indicates a formal restructuring process to achieve a consensual and orderly solution with creditors. No deal terms (price, premium, etc.) are provided. Watch for creditor negotiations and potential Chapter 15 recognition in U.S. courts.
